headline: G2 GOLDFIELDS DRILLS TO 1KM DEPTH: 84.5m at 3.0 g/t Au as C$3B G Mining Takeover Closes In
snippet: G2 Goldfields extended its OKO Project in Guyana to 1 kilometre depth with hole GDD277B returning 84.5m at 3.0 g/t Au from 915m — including 16.4m at 4.5 g/t — extending the high-grade resource 140m vertically. Infill hole GDD270 also returned 20.8m at 9.6 g/t Au. Results arrive as G Mining Ventures' C$3B all-stock acquisition advances toward a Q2 2026 close.

headline: NEAR-SURFACE 9.47% COPPER EQ: Power Metallic Hits 17.45m High-Grade at Quebec NISK Lion Zone
snippet: Power Metallic Mines (TSX-V: PNPN) reported 17.45m of 9.47% CuEq (including 6.3m of 17.91% CuEq) and 39m of 5.66% CuEq from two infill holes at the Lion Zone of its Nisk polymetallic project in Quebec. The program is delineating high-grade geometry at roughly 100m depth ahead of a 2026 mineral resource estimate.

headline: GOLD DROPS to $4,583 as Trump Orders Naval Escorts Through Strait of Hormuz, Iran Threatens Response
snippet: Spot gold fell 0.63% to $4,583.60/oz on Monday after President Trump announced US forces would escort commercial tankers through the Strait of Hormuz and Iran warned it would target any American forces entering the strait. The move adds geopolitical complexity to a metal already down more than 15% from its January record of $5,405.

headline: USAR ROCKETED 72% IN APRIL: How the $2.8B Serra Verde Deal Could Break China's Rare Earth Grip
snippet: USA Rare Earth (NASDAQ: USAR) gained 72% in April, fuelled by its $2.8B agreement to acquire Brazil's Serra Verde Group — owner of a producing mine rich in Dysprosium, Terbium, and Yttrium. Analysts note the deal positions USAR as a credible non-China alternative for heavy rare earth supply chains critical to EV motors and defence systems.

headline: CHINA IMPORTED 790+ TONNES of Silver in Early 2026: Structural Demand Shows No Signs of Cooling
snippet: The weekly Gold SWOT report highlights Chinese silver imports exceeding 790 tonnes in early 2026, driven largely by solar panel manufacturing and industrial demand. With structural silver deficits now entering a fifth consecutive year, the combination of industrial consumption and a constrained supply pipeline reinforces the long-term bull case for silver.

headline: BANK OF AMERICA Holds $6,000 Gold Target: Silver to Average $86/oz in 2026
snippet: Reaffirming its 12-month gold price target of $6,000/oz despite the correction from January's $5,405 peak, Bank of America cited durable central bank buying, de-dollarization flows, and inflation hedging as structural pillars. BofA also forecasts silver averaging $86/oz in 2026 — implying roughly 15% upside from current levels near $75.

headline: COT WATCH: Gold Speculative Longs Pull Back from January Extremes as Positioning Resets for Next Move
snippet: The weekly Commitments of Traders breakdown as of April 28, 2026 shows managed-money net long positioning in gold has retreated significantly from January's extreme readings — a setup that historically precedes the next sustained advance. Silver net longs also contracted during the correction, with USDX positioning showing strengthening dollar bets.

headline: FOUNDERS METALS Hits Highest Grade Yet at Antino: 6m of 12.95 g/t Au Extends Zone 250m West
snippet: Founders Metals (TSX-V: FDR) returned its best composite interval from Lower Antino — 6.0m of 12.95 g/t Au from 55m depth — extending mineralization approximately 250m west of prior drilling. Four diamond drill rigs are active across the 102,360-hectare Antino Gold District in Suriname's Guiana Shield, with results pending from all targets.

headline: NGEX MINERALS Drills 48m at 7.72% CuEq at Argentina's Lunahuasi; New Copper Zone Found 300m East
snippet: NGEx Minerals (TSX: NGEX) closed Phase 4 drilling at its Lunahuasi high-grade copper-gold project in San Juan, Argentina with 34m at 7.25% CuEq and 48m at 7.72% CuEq in the Mars Zone — results 180m apart — and a new discovery zone 300m east returning 23m at 4.72% CuEq. Phase 5 planning is underway on what may be a world-class porphyry system.

headline: Who's WINNING the 2026 Junior Mining Exploration Race? Stable African Jurisdictions Emerge as Rivals to the Americas
snippet: With junior mining budgets recovering on the back of gold near record levels, African Mining Online surveys which companies and jurisdictions are best positioned in 2026. Botswana, Namibia, and Côte d'Ivoire are highlighted as policy-stable jurisdictions attracting capital that was once directed almost exclusively to the Americas.

headline: GOLD CORRECTION DEEPENS: Technical Update Flags USD Strength and 200 EMA Support as Near-Term Headwinds
snippet: A May 2 technical review puts the gold sector on a 'cycle down' signal, with US dollar strength countering the longer-term bull case in the near term and the model looking for support at the 200 EMA before any resumption. Gold stocks may face continued selling pressure until the correction — now roughly 15% off the January $5,405 peak — runs its course.
